Crediting Kenney is requested but not required.
notes: Last Descent rooms (#51): obelisks, name plaques, standing stones, columns, an altar, lanterns, braziers, urns and debris. Every GLB references the shared Textures/colormap.png (this kit's own copy; it differs from kenney-fantasy-town's). LastDescent.tsx renders them with tinted copies of that texture.
